Theorem
[Space-time mean value property on Euclidean space] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0387, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0388 ↗ clm:chow-iii-euclidean-heat-ball-normalization-exercise ↗ lem:chow-iii-euclidean-heat-ball-average-stationary 1. ch26:26.39\group Heat Balls

If $u_t=\Delta u$ on $\mathbb R^n\times [0,t]$ and $t\ge r^2/(4\pi )>0$, then \[ u(x,t)=\frac1{4r^n}\iint _{E_r(x,t)}u(y,s) \frac{|x-y|^2}{(t-s)^2}\, d\mu _E(y)ds. \]
